title: Go Live preview: combined camera + microphone permission prompt with denial messaging

requirements.summary: Trigger a single combined browser permission prompt (camera + microphone) when the Go Live start form mounts, and ensure all media tracks are stopped on close/navigate away.
acceptanceCriteria: When an authenticated user clicks "Go Live" (or opens /live?startLive=1) and the start form is shown, the app immediately triggers a single browser permission request that includes both Camera and Microphone access.
The permission request is only triggered for the Go Live preview/start form flow on /live, and does not introduce new permission prompts elsewhere in the app.
If the user closes the start form or navigates away, any active media tracks created for the preview are stopped and the device indicator turns off (no camera/mic left running).

file_operations.description: Use the selected camera component hook (camera/useCamera) for the preview, but add a mount-time preflight call to navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with both video and audio to force a single combined permission prompt; immediately stop the preflight stream tracks after permission resolution, then start the camera preview via useCamera. Add robust cleanup to stop the useCamera stream on unmount so no camera/mic tracks remain active. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the preview component only mounts when the authenticated user's Start a Live Session card is shown (current behavior) and that closing the form unmounts the preview (so cleanup runs). Optionally add a remount key when reopening the form so the combined permission prompt preflight runs exactly when the form is opened.

requirements.summary: Show a clear in-preview error state when camera and/or microphone permission is denied, explicitly mentioning both and noting the user can still start a live session without the preview.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user denies either Camera or Microphone permission, the Go Live preview area shows an error state (not a silent failure).

The error message is in English and explicitly references both camera and microphone permissions (example acceptable wording: "Camera or microphone permission denied. You can still create a live session without the preview.").
The existing "local-only preview" explanatory copy remains accurate and is still shown when the preview is successfully running.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated error state for the combined audio+video permission preflight (e.g., denied/dismissed), and update existing permission-related messaging from the camera hook so it explicitly references both camera and microphone permissions and clarifies the session can still be created without the preview; keep the existing local-only preview explanatory copy visible when the preview is running successfully. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
